name: covenant-review
title_zh: 每条契约逐条比对证据，整包只签一次字
tagline_zh: 银行家最怕的不是漏看某条契约，而是逐条改完状态后忘了哪条已改。这里把整包契约读出来、逐条对着证据判定。
tagline_en: Reads the whole covenant package, checks each against evidence, stages one plan under one approval, then executes.
desc_en: Guided workflow. Assess the covenant package of a deal and record the results in nCino. Reads every covenant on the product package with its current compliance status and reason, the banker assesses each one against the evidence, and the whole set is staged as ONE plan under ONE decision token, then executed per covenant. Use when a banker says "review the covenants", "run the covenant review", "r
why_zh: 不是逐条弹窗让你点，而是先摊开全部契约与当前合规状态和理由，判定完再一次性提交。
why_en: It surfaces every covenant with its current status and reason first, then commits the whole set as one plan instead of one popup.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 nCino 里已挂到产品包的契约，没进包的条款它读不到；判定依据要你自己提供证据，它不会去翻信贷档案。
limit_en: Only covenants already attached to the product package in nCino; you must supply the evidence; execution is per covenant and halts on the failed one.
title_en: Review every covenant against evidence, sign once
